turns.content: New year, new me. I'm starting a strict budget: 800€ rent, 300€ groceries, 150€ going out. Everything above that goes to savings.
Got it — 1250€ monthly spending cap, surplus to savings. I'll keep track.
Also signed up for the gym near work, the FitLab on Rosenthaler Straße. Tuesday and Thursday mornings before standup.
My sister Lena's birthday is March 14th. She's been hinting about ceramics classes, remind me to book one in early March.
Also for the record: my landlord's contact is Herr Weber, weber.hausverwaltung@example.com — I always lose that email.
Work update: I got staffed on the Meridian project, it's a data platform migration for a logistics client. I'm the backend lead.
Congrats on the lead role! Noted that you're backend lead on Meridian.
The catch is a weekly Wednesday 7am call with the Singapore team. So I'm moving my Thursday gym slot to Friday.
Booked the ceramics class for Lena — March 9th at Studio Ton in Kreuzberg, 65€ for the two of us. Comes out of the going-out budget.
The ceramics class was a hit, Lena loved it. She made a bowl, I made something that might be an ashtray.
Budget check: February came in 90€ over on groceries but 200€ under on going out. Net positive.
Big change: my rent is going up to 950€ from June. Adjusting the budget — groceries stay at 300€, going out drops to 100€.
Also the Meridian project got extended through September. The Singapore call moved to Thursdays 8am, so I can go back to Tuesday/Thursday gym... wait no, Thursday is out. Tuesday and Friday it stays.
Started learning Portuguese on the side — 20 minutes every morning before work, aiming for basic conversation by summer.
Because: I'm planning a week in Lisbon with Lena in July, budget 900€ total for the both of us. She's covering flights, I'm covering the apartment.
Lisbon is booked! Apartment in Alfama, July 15-22, 480€ my share. Leaves 420€ for everything else.
Gym update: FitLab is closing their Rosenthaler location in June. Switching to their Prenzlauer Berg branch, same schedule.
Meridian milestone shipped — the ingestion pipeline is live. My manager Dara hinted at a promotion conversation in the September review.
First month of the new 950€ rent. Going-out budget of 100€ is rough but holding.
